treatment: Do not introduce this release as new in a later delta brief. Repeat only for model card, weights/license details, independently reproducible benchmarks, material availability changes, or significant deployment/adoption evidence.
known_facts: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Lightning as an open model aimed at code review, tool use, security alert monitoring, billing questions and other enterprise tasks.
NVIDIA positioned the model as a smaller, lower-cost option than larger frontier systems.
WSJ coverage was published at 2026-08-11 13:04 UTC (22:04 JST), before the prior 23:30 JST LLM Night Lite boundary; the later Reuters article appeared at 23:31 JST.
reinclude_only_if: Official model card or weights/license details materially change practical interpretation.
Independent reproducible evaluation establishes a meaningful capability or efficiency delta.
A major deployment or compatibility change materially affects use.
notes: Recovered into the ledger for future dedupe, but excluded from the 2026-08-12 Midday main report because the release was already publicly visible before the prior night boundary. NeMo Switchyard also had public availability before this run.
